def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker_counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != background)
    marker = marker_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(a + 1, b):
                if out[r][c] == background:

    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
